shared_elements: curving band or belt-like element across the body
carved relief on a flat-fronted surface
justification: Both show anthropomorphic figures accompanied by round disc-like motifs and a curved band crossing the torso, but that is about as generic as figural carving gets. A is a symmetrical, densely detailed scene of two winged, bearded attendants flanking an elaborate branching tree above a band of script-like signs, whereas B is a single blocky frontal figure with a heavy headdress and a few large plain circles, with no flanking composition, no tree, no wings and no inscription band.
